verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
For Thou, O Lord art high above all the earth
Thou art exalted far above all gods

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
I exalt Thee
I exalt Thee
I exalt Thee, O Lord

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
You are worthy
You are worthy
You are worthy, O Lord

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
We exalt Thee
We exalt Thee
We exalt Thee, O Lord
